bull_bear.body:
- Large student community: 4.46 million Total Paid Users in FY25 (59.19% CAGR FY23-FY25); 98.80 million YouTube subscribers across 207 channels as at June 30, 2025
- Presence across 13 Education Categories (up from six as at March 31, 2023) delivered via online, offline and hybrid channels
- Most affordable pricing among top-5 organized players (e.g. JEE Class 12 course at Rs 4,500 vs Rs 75,000-80,000 for peers)
- Proprietary technology stack and AI tools (AI Guru, AI Grader, Smart Doubt Engine, AI Sahayak, PW Drona, TeacherX)
- Network effects from open-access free content funneling into paid online, offline and hybrid channels
- Specialized faculty (6,267 Total Faculty Members as at June 30, 2025) and content library (4,382 books, 8.66 million question banks)
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- History of losses and negative net worth — Restated loss of Rs 2,432.58 million in FY25, Rs 11,311.30 million in FY24 and Rs 840.75 million in FY23; negative net worth as at March 31, 2024 and negative EBITDA in FY24 and Q1 FY26
- Limited operating history — Company started operations in 2020; limited history in offline channels and integrating acquisitions
- Dependence on founders/key faculty — Business heavily reliant on founders Alakh Pandey and Prateek Boob and on faculty; attrition or reputational damage could hurt brand
- Offline expansion execution risk — Rapid offline center rollout; exact locations for New PW Centers not yet identified and no definitive lease arrangements
- Reliance on franchisee-operated hybrid centers — Majority of hybrid centers operated by franchisees over which the company has less control
- Concentration in JEE/NEET test-prep categories — Significant revenue from a few flagship categories; regulatory or exam-pattern changes could affect demand
- Redseer report reliance — Industry data commissioned and paid for by the company and not independently verified
- Acquisition integration risk — Growth partly via acquisitions (Xylem, Utkarsh, Knowledge Planet); integration and goodwill/impairment risk
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: PhysicsWallah offers test preparation courses for competitive examinations (such as JEE, NEET, UPSC, GATE and other government examinations) and other courses such as upskilling. Delivery is through online channels (social media, website and apps), tech-enabled offline centers ('Vidyapeeth') and hybrid two-teacher centers ('Pathshala'). As at June 30, 2025 it offered courses across 13 Education Categories via 303 Total Offline Centers, monetising a large free YouTube/social-media community into free and paid users.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Test preparation:** JEE, NEET, Foundation, Board and CUET, Chartered Accountancy, Civil Services Examinations, Commerce, Defence, GATE, Other Government Examinations, MBA
- **Skills / Upskilling:** data science and analytics, banking and finance, software development
business.title: Products & brands

business.body:
- Xylem Learning Private Limited — Subsidiary: Acquired Fiscal 2024 to strengthen presence in South India; operates offline centers and hostels
- Utkarsh Classes & Edutech Private Limited — Subsidiary: Acquired Fiscal 2023 for government-examination categories in Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh
- Knowledge Planet Holdings Limited — Subsidiary: Acquired Fiscal 2023/2024 for Middle East operations
- PW Foundation — Subsidiary (non-profit): Runs scholarship and social programs
- Penpencil Edu Services Private Limited — Subsidiary: Prateek Boob is a director
- Sheryians Private Limited — Group Company: Identified group company

outlook.body:
- Increase student engagement and brand recall via engaging pedagogy, tech tools and targeted marketing
- Expand and enhance offerings across multiple Education Categories and languages (seven languages as at June 30, 2025)
- Develop multi-channel presence by growing offline and hybrid centers using a hyperlocal, data-driven approach
- Invest in expanding cloud/server capacity and developing AI tools (e.g. AI NCERT, AI-powered personalized study path)
- Pursue inorganic growth through strategic acquisitions
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: PhysicsWallah plans to strategically expand its offline presence by opening new PW Vidyapeeth (offline), PW Pathshala (hybrid) and PW Other Centers, using data insights from its online community and a hyperlocal city-level hub approach. It intends to enter new cities where it has no direct offline presence, including Muzaffarpur, Dhanbad, Akola, Latur, Rajkot, Ujjain, Bhatinda, Jorhat and Chennai, plus new centers for subsidiaries Xylem and Utkarsh. As at June 30, 2025 it operated 303 Total Offline Centers across 152 cities in India and the Middle East (165.92% CAGR FY23-FY25). Locations are yet to be identified and all New PW Centers are to be operated on a leasehold basis.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Revenue growth driven by increase in paid users, expansion into new Education Categories and offline growth, plus acquisitions (Utkarsh FY23, Xylem FY24, Knowledge Planet)
- Losses driven by employee benefit and ESOP expenses, faculty professional fees, advertisement/publicity, server expenses and depreciation from offline center expansion
- FY24 loss inflated by one-time net loss on remeasurement of financial instruments at fair value (CCPS fair-valuation loss)
- Two revenue models: online fees collected at enrolment; offline/hybrid fees collected at enrolment or by installment, plus hostel/residential income
